capabilities: auto-add configured properties to new notes
mark a property sticky via right-click in the Properties panel
configure property types and default values in settings
stamp note creation time with a now/today date default
disambiguation: Not sticky or pinned notes; it auto-adds frontmatter properties to newly created notes.
extras: README warns the right-click menu relies on Obsidian's internal markup and may break after Obsidian updates, while automatic stamping would keep working.
problem: Obsidian creates new notes with empty frontmatter, so you have to manually add the same properties (like a creation date) to every note.
summary: Properties automation plugin that auto-adds a configured set of sticky frontmatter properties to every newly created note.
